## 📌 Description

Integrate Playwright with Java 21 and TestNG. Implement the very first UI test against a public demo site, establish browser lifecycle management, and basic assertions.



## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **Add Dependencies** (update `pom.xml`)

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.microsoft.playwright</groupId>
    <artifactId>playwright</artifactId>
    <version>1.59.0</version>
</dependency>

<dependency>
    <groupId>org.testng</groupId>
    <artifactId>testng</artifactId>
    <version>7.12.0</version>
</dependency>
```

- [ ] **Browser Manager**
  - Create `BrowserFactory.java` (singleton / thread-local pattern)
  - Support `chromium`, `firefox`, `webkit` via system property or config

- [ ] **Base Test Class**
  - `BaseTest.java` with `@BeforeSuite` / `@AfterSuite` for browser & context lifecycle
  - Graceful shutdown and screenshot capture on failure

- [ ] **First Test Case: TC_001**
  - Package: `tests`
  - Navigate to `https://demo.playwright.dev/todomvc`
  - Add a new todo item → verify it appears in the list
  - Use Playwright’s built-in auto-waiting assertions

- [ ] **TestNG Suite**
  - `testng.xml` defining the test class
  - Configure parallel execution (later milestone, but lay groundwork)

- [ ] **CI Integration**
  - Ensure `main-ci.yml` runs `mvn clean verify` with Playwright dependencies
  - Cache Playwright browsers in GitHub Actions (reduce build time)

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `mvn test` successfully runs `TC_001` against Chromium (headless in CI, headed locally)
- [ ] Browser is launched and closed cleanly for each test run
- [ ] Test failure produces a screenshot (even if simple for now)

## 📎 Dependencies
- [ ] `v0.0.0` project structure and CI must be complete

## 🧪 Validation Steps
- [ ] `mvn clean test -Dbrowser=chromium`
- [ ] `./scripts/pom-validator.sh` — must report Playwright & TestNG as pass
- [ ] PR to `dev` triggers `feature-pr.yml` — build succeeds
